mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) over the previous month indicates inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI increases do not correlate with subsequent FEDFUNDS increases.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the previous three months signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or UNRATE decreases do not correlate with subsequent GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the previous two months indicates a strengthening demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of instances following HOUST increases, or HOUST increases do not correlate with subsequent GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) over the previous month signals a weakening supply side of the economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO decreases do not correlate with subsequent GDP contraction.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 8% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase, it indicates a recovery in the labor market, which is a strong signal for positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 8% and PAYEMS increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the combination of high UNRATE and increasing PAYEMS does not correlate with subsequent economic recovery.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) combined with a rise in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals accommodative monetary policy supporting consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decreases > 0.25% and RSAFS increases > 1% in 1 month
regime_hint: monetary easing with consumer spending growth
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the combination of decreasing FEDFUNDS and increasing RSAFS does not correlate with subsequent economic growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over the previous six months indicates strong economic growth, which is a robust signal for positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances following GDPC1 increases, or GDPC1 increases do not correlate with subsequent corporate earnings growth.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases, it signals inflationary pressure with tight monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of high FEDFUNDS and increasing CPIAUCSL does not correlate with subsequent tightening monetary policy.
